series.name: Unstaked ETH
series.note: ETH held on the execution layer (WETH counted as ETH), less the ETH that issuers hold as backing already counted in their token's supply.

series.name: Illiquid staked ETH
series.note: ETH staked on the consensus layer (or deposited and on its way there) that no token on this page represents: stake less what the tokens represent of it.

series.name: stETH (Lido)
series.note: Lido's stETH, including what wstETH wraps; one stETH is one ETH of Lido's pooled ether. Its address is read from Lido's LidoLocator; the ETH in Lido's buffer is counted here, not as ETH.

series.name: wBETH (Binance)
series.note: Binance's wBETH at the exchange rate its contract publishes. ETH paid in to mint it waits in the account the contract names before going to Binance, and is counted here, not as ETH.

series.name: cbETH (Coinbase)
series.note: Coinbase's cbETH at the exchange rate its contract publishes. Coinbase holds its backing off the execution layer, so no ETH is netted for it.

series.name: rETH (Rocket Pool)
series.note: Rocket Pool's rETH at its exchange rate (getExchangeRate); the token is read from RocketStorage. The ETH in rETH's own contract and in the deposit pool is counted here, not as ETH.

series.name: mETH (Mantle)
series.note: Mantle's mETH at the rate its Staking contract quotes (mETHToETH), which also names the token. ETH the Staking contract holds is counted here, not as ETH.

series.name: LsETH (Liquid Collective)
series.note: Liquid Collective's LsETH (the River contract) at River's own conversion (underlyingBalanceFromShares). ETH River holds is counted here, not as ETH.

series.name: frxETH (Frax)
series.note: Frax's frxETH, issued 1:1 for ETH by its minter (which names the token), including what sfrxETH wraps. ETH the minter holds before depositing it is counted here, not as ETH.

series.name: swETH (Swell)
series.note: Swell's swETH at its contract's rate (swETHToETHRate); the token is read from the Deposit Manager's AccessControlManager. ETH the Deposit Manager holds is counted here, not as ETH.
